svg.title: FlavorStack LLD Domain Groups
svg.desc: Six bounded contexts for FlavorStack: Identity, Catalog, Commerce, Fulfillment, Engagement, and Platform

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me the LLD for the Identity domain in FlavorStack: User, Admin, Rider models, RBAC, JWT, sessions')
sendPrompt('Give me the LLD for the Catalog domain in FlavorStack: Restaurant, MenuItem, Category, OpeningHours, DeliveryZone models')
sendPrompt('Give me the LLD for the Commerce domain in FlavorStack: Cart, Order, OrderItem, Payment, Coupon, Wallet models')
sendPrompt('Give me the LLD for the Fulfillment domain in FlavorStack: Delivery, RiderAssignment, TrackingEvent, Refund, OutboxEvent models')
sendPrompt('Give me the LLD for the Engagement domain in FlavorStack: Review, Loyalty, Referral, Notification, ChatMessage, Conversation models')
sendPrompt('Give me the LLD for the Platform domain in FlavorStack: AnalyticsEvent, FeatureFlag, AuditLog, HealthCheck, BullMQ workers')

svg.text: Click any domain to go deeper into its LLD →
